extracted.name: Carrot and orange soup
extracted.description: This recipe was submitted by Good Food member Ben Halsey and has not been tested by our team.
ingredient_lines: a small handful coriander leaves chopped
instruction_lines: Heat the oil and gently sauté the onions, until soft and golden. Add the carrots and fry for a further 1-2 minutes.
Combine the stock, orange juice, ground coriander, cinnamon. Stir in the wet ingredients and cover. Simmer for 40-50 minutes or until the carrots are tender.
Liquidize the ingredients to your desired consistency. Season to taste and garnish with the coriander leaves.
